title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo on 1991-08-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > dBpoweramp > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures the memorable rain‑filled Cal Expo concert.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller SBD mix is praised as ‘just right,’ delivering a clear and well‑balanced recording of an iconic rainy show at Cal Expo. Reviewers describe the performance as memorable, making this release a must‑listen for fans despite the lack of specific song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both superb recording quality and an iconic show, warranting a high rating but confidence is low due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller mix down is described as 'just right' – clear, balanced and well‑engineered.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Memorable rain‑soaked concert at Cal Expo noted for its overall impact rather than individual song details.
